description: This file defines a Java interface for reading external asset owner loan product attributes within the Fineract project. It declares a method to retrieve all loan product attributes by loan product ID and attribute key, returning a paginated result.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesReadService
classes.description: A Java interface responsible for retrieving external transfer loan product attributes based on loan product ID and attribute key, supporting pagination.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductAttributesByLoanProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of external transfer loan product attributes filtered by loan product ID and attribute key.
